dreamteamer.title: Core
dreamteamer.description: Every workspace's nouns, composed from the small official modules into one install: `users` with `roles` and `responsibilities`; `companies`, `contacts`, `engagements`; `tasks`; `projects` with `decisions`, `risks` and `teams`; `meetings` with recordings and docs; `files`; `assets` and `artifacts`; `sessions` and `metrics`; `workflows`. Install core OR the small modules, never both.
